eyebrow: SQL Server Database Administration · Chapter Three
subtitle: Lesson 14 · Database Creation & Configuration

code:
CREATE DATABASE Sales
ON PRIMARY
(
    NAME = N'Sales',
    FILENAME = N'D:\SQLData\Sales.mdf',
    SIZE = 1024MB,
    MAXSIZE = 51200MB,
    FILEGROWTH = 256MB
)
LOG ON
(
    NAME = N'Sales_log',
    FILENAME = N'L:\SQLLogs\Sales_log.ldf',
    SIZE = 256MB,
    MAXSIZE = 20480MB,
    FILEGROWTH = 128MB
);
caption: ON PRIMARY sets the data file; LOG ON sets the log — the log never belongs to a filegroup.
